players.product: TSMC-ecosystem (VCA) turnkey ASIC design and wafer supply, incl. AI accelerator and memory-controller SoCs

quarterly_data.signal: Deck (10-12-2026), 2024-2026 milestones (contracts named by the company): a new RF chip contract with US company PHYTunes; joint development cooperation on a global AI server chip with Taiwanese company Aegis Technology (name transliterated from the Korean deck); an automotive semiconductor design supply contract with a US integrated device manufacturer (IDM); a programmable SoC mass-production contract with a global customer; a development contract with US neuromorphic AI company Brainchip; a new project contract with a Malaysian company; a new edge AI chip contract; an eSSD controller development contract with FADU; an AI VPU development contract with Supergate; a chiplet SoC development contract with Primemas and an expansion of CXL controller development with Primemas; a storage controller mass-production contract. The deck also lists development and mass production of FADU's high-performance eSSD controller
quarterly_data.counterparty: PHYTunes, Aegis Technology, Brainchip, FADU, Supergate, Primemas, undisclosed US IDM and global customer

quarterly_data.signal: Deck strategy and targets: the company presents itself as a key beneficiary of memory-market growth (AI infrastructure investment -> memory growth -> controller demand), with completed development projects entering mass production in sequence and profitability improving as the mass-production share of revenue rises. Its Taiwan R&D centre has set up N3-and-below process and CoWoS capability, and it says it has secured TSMC 2.5D (CoWoS)-based chiplet technology; it describes itself as Korea's only TSMC VCA and an Arm Total Design partner. Roadmap: Phase 1 (to 2025) Taiwan R&D centre and US office opened; Phase 2 (to 2027) CoWoS / advanced package promotion and more N3-N28 AI, IoT and consumer projects; Phase 3 (to 2029) a US subsidiary, targeted for 2028, and more global turnkey and mass-production projects. The company claims its AxHub edge AI chip platform cuts development time and cost by 60% or more
quarterly_data.figure: US subsidiary targeted for 2028; AxHub time / cost cut 60%+ (company claim)

connects_to.relationship: custom ASIC design services for SK Hynix
